name: azure
description: Official CC Safety Net rulebook for destructive Azure CLI operations. Curated coverage, not a complete model of the Azure CLI.
author: cc-safety-net

rules.name: block-az-group-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a resource group and every resource inside it. Ask the user to delete resource groups.

rules.name: block-az-vm-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a virtual machine; attached disks may be deleted depending on flags. Ask the user to delete VMs; 'az vm deallocate' stops compute charges but other resources can still incur charges.

rules.name: block-az-aks-delete
rules.reason: Deletes an AKS cluster. Ask the user to delete clusters.

rules.name: block-az-storage-account-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a storage account and all data in it. Ask the user to delete storage accounts.

rules.name: block-az-sql-server-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a SQL server and every database on it. Ask the user to delete SQL servers.

rules.name: block-az-sql-db-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a database and its data. Ask the user to delete databases.

rules.name: block-az-keyvault-purge
rules.reason: Permanently deletes a soft-deleted key vault; purged secrets and keys cannot be recovered. Ask the user to purge vaults.

rules.name: block-az-resource-delete
rules.reason: Deletes the resource named by ID or type. Stop and explain the target and dependent resources before asking the user to delete it.

rules.name: block-az-cosmosdb-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a Cosmos DB account and its databases and containers. Recovery depends on backup mode. Ask the user to delete accounts.

rules.name: block-az-storage-container-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a storage container and all blobs in it. Recovery requires container soft delete. Ask the user to delete containers.

rules.name: block-az-storage-blob-delete
rules.reason: Deletes a blob. Recovery requires blob soft delete or versioning. Ask the user to delete blobs.
